description: City-wide short-term rental summary for one city, from Inside Airbnb: total listings, overall median nightly price (in that city's own local currency -- see the `currency` field, e.g. CZK for Prague, never converted), a breakdown by room type (entire home/apt, private room, shared room, hotel room -- each with its own count and median price), and the top neighbourhoods by listing count (each with its own listing count and median price). Pass a city name (e.g. "Paris", "NYC", "San Francisco") or its slug (e.g. "new-york-city"). Returns data_as_of = that city's own Inside Airbnb scrape date. An uncovered city is refused by name, listing every covered city rather than returning an empty result -- call list_str_cities to browse the full set.
name: str_city_summary
title: Str City Summary
